about.title: About this project
about.metaDescription: How NexStore AI is built: hybrid semantic search, Supabase, Stripe and Next.js.
about.intro: NexStore AI is a full-stack e-commerce storefront, built as a portfolio project. It is a real, working application — not a clickable mockup — but it is not running a business.

sections.heading: What is worth a look
items: Search by meaning. Queries are embedded with the gte-small model and matched against the catalogue with pgvector, then fused with a keyword ranker. “Film my surfing trip” finds the action camera without sharing a word with it.
A checkout you cannot tamper with. The browser sends only product ids and quantities; prices are re-read from the database before Stripe sees them.
Row-level security everywhere. Every table is protected in Postgres itself, not only in the UI.
Three languages. The interface and the catalogue are in English, Spanish and Russian, each at its own URL.
An admin panel for products, photos, stock and order status.

sections.heading: Stack
paragraphs: Next.js 16 (App Router) · React 19 · TypeScript · Tailwind CSS v4 · next-intl · Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, pgvector) · Stripe · Zod · Vitest, deployed on Vercel.

sections.heading: Source
paragraphs: The code, architecture notes and known limitations are on <link>GitHub</link>.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.metaDescription: What NexStore AI stores about you, where, and why.
privacy.intro: Short, because the store collects very little.

sections.heading: What is stored
items: Your account — email address and, if you give one, your name. Held by Supabase Auth.
Your activity — orders, wishlist and reviews, tied to your account in the store’s Supabase database. Row-level security means only you (and the store admin, for orders) can read them.
Your cart — kept in your own browser’s local storage, not on a server.
Search queries — processed to find products and not saved.

Request counters — to stop floods of checkout and search requests, the store counts requests per visitor for a few minutes. It stores a one-way keyed hash of your IP address (or account id), never the address itself, and deletes the counters within a day.

Error reports — if the deployment has error monitoring (Sentry) turned on, a crash report records the page, browser type and the technical error. Cookies, IP addresses, email addresses, form contents and URL query strings are removed before it is sent.

sections.heading: Payments
paragraphs: Checkout happens on Stripe’s own page. Card details go straight to Stripe and never pass through this store’s servers.

sections.heading: Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: The only cookies are the ones that keep you signed in and one that remembers the language you chose. There is no analytics, no advertising and no third-party tracking; the error reports above are the only thing that may go to a third party. Fonts are self-hosted, so loading a page does not contact Google.

sections.heading: Deleting your data
paragraphs: To have your account and everything tied to it removed, open an issue on the <link>project’s GitHub</link>.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.metaDescription: The terms for using the NexStore AI demo store.

sections.heading: A demo, not a shop
paragraphs: Placing an order here creates a test order only. No contract of sale is formed and nothing will be delivered.

sections.heading: Products and prices
paragraphs: Product names, descriptions, stock levels and prices are sample data. Photos come from Unsplash and are used under the Unsplash License.

sections.heading: Accounts and reviews
items: Keep your sign-in details to yourself; you are responsible for activity on your account.
Reviews must be your own and must not be abusive or unlawful. They may be removed.
Test data, including accounts, may be reset at any time.

sections.heading: No warranty
paragraphs: The site is provided as is, without any guarantee that it is available, accurate or free of errors.

shipping.title: Shipping & returns
shipping.metaDescription: Delivery times, free shipping, 30-day returns and the 1-year warranty.
shipping.intro: The policy a real NexStore would run — the one the product pages promise.

sections.heading: Shipping
items: Free standard shipping on every order within the EU.
Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days and usually arrive 2–5 business days later.
You can follow each order’s status — paid, shipped, delivered — on your account page.

sections.heading: Returns
items: Return any item within 30 days of delivery, for any reason.
Items must be unused and in their original packaging.
Refunds go back to the original payment method once the return arrives.

sections.heading: Warranty
paragraphs: Every product carries a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects. This does not affect your statutory rights as a consumer in the EU.
